title: Car kit — declarative GT1-style car body
description: Input to tools/build-car.js, which lofts it into a Scene Forge project (.forge.json) for hand-tweak + photo texturing. All dimensions in GAME METERS (the builder divides by CONFIG.carScale to author at gltf scale). Car faces +Z: zFrac 0 = nose, 1 = tail.

id.description: Slug — becomes the output filename and suggested ASSETS.carModels id

length.description: Overall body length, m. Baseline White #7 is 2.40 m

width.description: Overall body width, m. Baseline is 0.92 m

sideProfile.description: The side silhouette as two nose→tail polylines; the builder closes them into one ring (top, then bottom reversed). Read these straight off a profile photo.

top.description: [zFrac 0..1, yMeters] upper silhouette: bumper top → hood → windshield → roof → deck → tail. Each segment becomes one textureable face strip (Hood/Windshield/Roof/... named by slope+position), so put points where panels change.

bottom.description: [zFrac, yMeters] lower silhouette nose→tail (floor line, usually 3-4 points). y must stay below top's y. Wheels are NOT modeled — the game rig adds them (WHEEL/buildPlayerCar).

planTaper.description: Optional [zFrac, widthFrac 0..1] pairs: body half-width as a fraction of width/2, interpolated along the length (nose/tail pinch). Omit = constant width slab.

bodyColor.description: Hex flat fill for body faces (placeholder until photo texturing), default #b8bec8

glassColor.description: Hex flat fill for Windshield/Rear Glass faces, default #1c222e

boxes.description: Optional extra cuboid objects (spoiler, scoop). Own object each — movable/deletable in Scene Forge.

pos.description: [x,y,z] meters, same frame as the body

wheels.description: Wheel centers in game meters — NOT geometry; emitted as the ASSETS.carModels registration snippet (wheelOffset). Baseline (White #7): x 0.44*carScale... see WHEEL in placeholders.js; omit fields that match baseline. Also drives the painted wheel-arch positions in the livery.

livery.description: Presence turns on the automatic texturing pass: build-car runs tools/paint-car.py (GT1-style flat livery — beltline, roundel numbers, sponsors, windows/arches painted into the side view) and wires every body face as a real Scene Forge photo grab into the generated side_right/side_left/wrap paintings — so each face stays hand-editable (handles, Detail/Colors/Dither) afterward. Omit for flat-color fills. --no-paint skips it.

stripeColor.description: Twin racing stripes over nose/hood/roof/deck/tail, default #b02030

team.description: Hood lettering (painted to read from the nose), default PLACEHOLDER GP

sponsors.description: Up to 3: front fender, rear quarter, rocker
